lead_profile_text: Looking to buy a property for short term letting

delay_signals.trigger_phrase: So we've agreed the sale. It should have been off the market... we're progressing now.
delay_signals.context: Mortgaged purchase, sale agreed but not completed; conveyancers/mortgage in progress; surveyor visiting the following week.
delay_signals.timeline_given: Hoping to complete by November 2026, then works, then listing.

delay_signals.trigger_phrase: there's one parking space. I'd like to expand to 2... surveyor going in next week... there's quite a lot of decking outside... it's slippery.
delay_signals.context: Pre-listing works needed: parking expansion, decking safety assessment/remediation, general survey.
delay_signals.timeline_given: Best case first bookings December 2026; worst case February 2027.

meeting_flow.opening_phrase: We're on now... thanks for coming on. I'll finalize that postcode and send it to you today.
meeting_flow.pivot_to_business: So I suppose what I'll do is we'll go through some figures first, then the benefits of managing yourself, then how the service works.
meeting_flow.income_intro: based off of your inquiry and the address... about £5,200 gross... about £5,300 gross.
meeting_flow.how_it_works_transition: we'll list you on multiple platforms — Airbnb, Booking.com, and our own direct booking site.
meeting_flow.pre_close_setup: As far as timeframes, have you got a date in mind?
meeting_flow.close_phrase: I'll send that over to you today with that revised document. If you have any concerns, just send it back to me.

lead_responses.zac_responded_with: 15% of the Airbnb payment, after platform commission but before cleaning.
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: That's a massive difference — we were using Houst, taking 18%.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: £1,300 seems high for a low month like January — sometimes we get zero bookings.
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Explained the seasonal ramp-up, importance of an established listing, ~82/100 direct booking potential.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: Do you screen out party bookings? (referencing a prior manager allowing parties)
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Lincoln isn't a party-booking area; £100 deposit, ID/background/review checks, optional noise sensor.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: If it's a small tear that's increasing, when is it reported/fixed?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Minor wear-and-tear batched; £300+/month flagged for owner approval.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: (Implicit interest in using own trusted maintenance people)
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Offered to coordinate with lead's own contractors.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: No secure cupboard on site — do you need one?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Nice to have but not essential.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: How do we book cleans if we book it ourselves?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Requested via a shared Slack channel; appears on monthly statement.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: Something will go wrong and we'll think we could've done this ourselves all along.
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Reframed via scaling argument — in-house nearby, local manager for distant properties.
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: It makes sense... I'll speak to my wife.

conversion_gaps.gap: No firm follow-up meeting or check-in date booked
conversion_gaps.evidence: Lead closed with 'I'll speak to my wife and see what we think.'
conversion_gaps.how_to_fill: Set a proactive check-in trigger for purchase completion (~November) and refurb completion.

conversion_gaps.gap: Setup quote fully deferred with no indicative figure given live
conversion_gaps.evidence: 'I'll give you a price for that come the time.'
conversion_gaps.how_to_fill: Give an indicative setup range live to anchor Stayful as the provider.

conversion_gaps.gap: Fee described as '15%' live without VAT uplift or clarity on which payout components it hits

conversion_gaps.evidence: The historic street market was scrapped in 2023; only a smaller cathedral market remains.
conversion_gaps.how_to_fill: Reference only the current, smaller ticketed market.

conversion_gaps.gap: Live 'likely case £2,800/mo' figure ~20% above the underlying forecast run-rate (£2,286/mo)
conversion_gaps.how_to_fill: Reconcile deck output against forecast array before the call.

conversion_gaps.gap: Deck incorrectly states 'No mortgage / owned outright' for a mortgaged purchase
conversion_gaps.how_to_fill: Correct the property finance field before future materials.

positive_shift_moments: Fee charged on post-commission payout, not gross — 'that's a massive difference.'
Offer to coordinate the lead's own trusted contractors.
Maintenance batching + £300 owner-approval cap reassured on surprise costs.
Scaling/operational-headache argument landed near the close.
Local Lincoln cleaner proximity anecdote reassured without overselling.
friction_moments: Fee-base challenge referencing a prior bad experience with Houst.
January income figure challenged against the lead's own portfolio history.
Party-booking/neighbour-noise concern from a previous manager.
Repeated articulation of the self-manage-vs-outsource tension.

opening_phrases: I'll finalize that postcode and send it to you today.
transition_phrases: we'll go through some of the figures first, then the benefits of managing yourself, then how the service works.
reassurance_phrases: There's sort of no surprises when it comes to that.
I wouldn't worry too much, in all honesty.
It's not the end of the world.
emphasis_phrases: You need very good cleaners, very good contacts for maintenance.
analogies_used: Once it's nice, it's just blank canvas, and then we can go in, get it all set up.
numbers_framing: 15% fee on Airbnb payout, after commission, before cleaning
zac_language.objection_handling_pattern: Acknowledge the concern as generally valid, narrow it to why it doesn't apply here, offer a concrete mitigation without overselling certainty.

profile_psychology_intersection.note: No canonical Monday archetype. Behaviour (interrogating fee base, catching the January figure against his own data, probing party-vetting) reads as analytical-evaluator — inference only.
profile_psychology_intersection.pre_meeting_presentation_signals: Two prior visits: 2026-09-07 (main concern 'understanding all the costs') and 2026-09-08 (main concern 'managing remotely', 'more confident now').
